about.title: About EzyChat Lite
about.description: One WhatsApp number, one shared inbox for your whole team — served from your own computer.

credits.customFeature: Need a custom feature? Contact Anchor Sprint

updates.title: App updates
updates.current: No newer published release is available.
updates.automatic: This computer checks GitHub for new releases automatically.
updates.keepsWorking: Your inbox keeps working while this downloads.
updates.howManaged: Download the update first. When it is ready, choose Restart and update and approve the system prompt. The app and any installed background service will restart automatically. Your accounts, chats and settings are preserved.
updates.howManual: Download the installer, quit this app from the tray menu, then install the new version. Your accounts, chats and settings stay on this computer.
updates.noInstaller: A compatible installer is not available for this computer yet. See the release on GitHub for details.
updates.interrupt: Updating briefly interrupts team access. Choose a quiet time.
updates.interruptManual: Updating briefly interrupts team access. Choose a quiet time. For a Windows service, stop it before installing and start it afterward. On Mac, remove the service before installing and enable it afterward to refresh its protected app copy.
updates.unverified: This release cannot be verified for installation here. Open the release on GitHub for a manual installer.

notice.label: App update available
notice.title: EzyChat Lite {{version}} is available
notice.preview: A new preview release is ready on GitHub.
notice.release: A new release is ready on GitHub.

share.title: Share this app
share.description: Tell others about your free team inbox. You choose what to post.
share.caption: I'm using EzyChat Lite — a free WhatsApp team inbox that runs on my own computer. One number, a shared inbox for my team, and I own my data.
share.privacy: This shares the public project page. Your private inbox address and conversations stay private.
share.socialHint: Copy your message first, then paste it into the post that opens.
share.instagramHint: Download the image, create a post in Instagram, then paste your copied message as the caption. Add the public link to your bio or a story link sticker.
share.imageAlt: EzyChat Lite: Free WhatsApp team inbox. Runs on your computer. You own your data.

feedback.messageCopied: Message and public link copied. Paste them into your post.
feedback.copyUnavailable: Copy is unavailable here. Select the message or link above and copy it manually.
feedback.shareUnavailable: Sharing is unavailable here. Select the message or link above and copy it manually.
feedback.imageStarted: Image download started. Upload it to Instagram and paste your caption.
feedback.imageFailed: Could not prepare the image. Try downloading again, or share the message and public link.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.description: Tell us about a problem, an idea or a question. The EzyChat team reads every message.

titlePlaceholder.problem: e.g. Photos from customers do not open
titlePlaceholder.idea: e.g. Let us schedule a message
titlePlaceholder.question: e.g. Can two people reply to the same chat?
titlePlaceholder.other: e.g. Thank you for the app

detailsPlaceholder.problem: What did you do, what happened, and what did you expect to happen?
detailsPlaceholder.idea: What would you like EzyChat to do, and how would it help your business?
detailsPlaceholder.question: Ask anything about using EzyChat.

files.label: Attachments
files.hint: Up to 3 files, 10 MB each: pictures, PDF, text or a short video.
files.tooMany: You can attach up to {{max}} files.
files.badType: {{name}} cannot be attached. Use a picture, PDF, text file or MP4 video.

contact.name: Your name
contact.ok: The EzyChat team may email me about this

include.detailsHint: Version, computer type, the screen you are on and connection status. No messages or customer details.
include.logHint: The last {{lines}} lines of the app log help us find problems. Phone numbers, emails, passwords and message text are removed first.

feedback.privacy: Your feedback goes to Anchor Sprint, the maker of {{product}}. We also record your internet address (IP) and country to help solve problems. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
feedback.github: Prefer GitHub? Report an issue there

sent.title: Feedback sent
sent.thanks: Thank you! Your feedback has reached the EzyChat team.
sent.reply: We will reply to {{email}} if we need more details.
sent.noReply: You asked us not to email you, so we will not reply.

errors.title: Write a short title (at least 3 characters).
errors.details: Tell us a bit more (at least 10 characters).
errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.emailRequired: Enter your email so we can reply.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, like name@company.com.
errors.fix: Fix the marked fields, then press Send again.
errors.unreachable: We could not reach the EzyChat team. Check the internet connection and try again; your text is kept.
errors.rateLimited: You have sent a lot of feedback in a short time. Please try again in 30 minutes; your text is kept.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again; your text is kept.
